name: TAP schaltet die aufgenommene Motion Sequence (TAP MOTION)

changes.note: TAP motion: the TAP switch, the TAP LED, and what the BLECH menu's TAP MOTION page writes (TM_SETTING)
the instruction before the call of the tap tempo calculation jumps to the hook
first instruction of the TAP LED beat flash jumps to the hook
first instruction of the LED manager's tick jumps to the hook

hooks.note: TAP with the patch on switches the motion and does not call the tap tempo calculation
with the patch on there is no beat flash on the TAP LED
keeps the TAP LED at the state of the motion and lets it go when the patch goes off

startPhase.why: the sequencer's first beat (about 100 ms, after the rescue paths at 57 to 60 ms) calls the TAP LED's beat flash, which now jumps to beat_hook
the LED manager's tick runs from about 140 ms, after the rescue paths, and now jumps to tick_hook

tm_active, beat_hook and tick_hook: at start they only look at the panel object, the kill switch, the card and the setting word and hand over to the firmware's own code; the rest runs on a key or when the patch is on

ram.what: run time state: TM_SETTING at +0 for the BLECH menu, the LED, the pattern number, the remembered modes
